authorization.basis: The user explicitly requested commit and public publication, then confirmed full scoped permission after the release gates were explained.
scope: source branch publication and pull request
update of the existing project-owned static Hugging Face Space

boundary: This receipt records a bounded review and reported scoped authorization. It does not authenticate identity, create consent for another person, prove governance legitimacy, or grant credentials.

affected_parties.notes: The fixtures contain no real participant records. Fictional roles do not identify known people.

credit.notes: The dataset card identifies project authorship, conceptual influences, and the absence of adapted external records without implying endorsement.

feedback_detail.notes: The target choices and rationales are project-authored evaluation keys, not collected participant feedback; feedback-specific annotation fields are not applicable.

generation.notes: All 18 fixtures are recorded as project-authored synthetic material. Authorship and non-adaptation are attestations; the reproducible lexical receipt supplies narrower comparison evidence.

grouping.notes: Every record has one unique ID and belongs to exactly one declared lane; no people, households, or participant clusters are represented.

license.notes: Apache-2.0 is declared consistently for the entire benchmark package, and the review found no bundled third-party records or code requiring a different component license.

pii.notes: Manual bounded review found no personal identifiers or real participant records in the 18 synthetic fixtures or release metadata.

privacy.notes: The package is suitable for public visibility because it contains project-authored synthetic scenarios and public project metadata only.

remedy.notes: Maintainers can stop future distribution, remove or correct material in later versions, and append a visible receipt; copies already downloaded cannot be guaranteed recalled.

secrets.notes: Review found no credentials, tokens, private keys, secret values, raw histories, or machine-specific private paths in the bounded release artifacts.

sensitive_content.notes: The fixtures discuss governance and safety controls abstractly and contain no reviewed sensitive personal content.

initial_blockers: A longest-choice shortcut scored 16/18 before distractor length balancing.
The report renderer accepted forged result semantics before result-to-manifest validation was hardened.
The first package omitted its standalone CLI.
Initial contamination wording overstated what lexical comparison could prove.
remediation: Choice wording was rebalanced; all eight published trivial baselines now score between 3/18 and 6/18.
Result receipts are bound to the current manifest, expected IDs, lanes, metrics, labels, coverage arithmetic, and eligible sample IDs.
The package includes its dependency-free CLI and package-root commands.
Authorship and non-paraphrase statements are labeled as author attestations and separated from reproducible lexical evidence.

contamination.limitations: Lexical comparison cannot prove semantic independence, novelty, or absence from unknown training corpora.

deduplication.method: Unique record IDs plus exact canonical record comparison across the three release files.

split.method: One immutable test-only split, separated into three non-composite evaluation configs with six records each.

publication_notes: Hugging Face benchmark registration is beta and allow-listed; dataset publication does not imply an official leaderboard.
Public download and Apache-2.0 distribution cannot provide revocation of copies already obtained.
No overall or composite score may be derived from this release receipt.
